what: A preview of a published agenda, for notice. An agenda lists what MAY be discussed; nothing here predicts an outcome. Every agenda_line is verbatim from the document.

preview.how_to_attend: In-person meeting, broadcast live on Lunenburg Public Access and Facebook Live, and available via Zoom for remote attendance (hybrid; meeting will not stop for tech problems). Join Zoom Meeting https://us02web.zoom.us/j/9091740347?omn=83813796157, Meeting ID: 909 174 0347, Phone: (888) 475-4499

items.agenda_line: Earth Removal Application Renewal for 780 Northfield Road by Jim Lattanzi
items.why_it_matters: The board is scheduled to take up a renewal of a permit allowing earth removal at this property.

items.agenda_line: Introduction of Jessica “Jak” Miller, Assistant Town Manager
items.why_it_matters: A new Assistant Town Manager is being introduced to the board and public.

items.agenda_line: Acknowledgment of the Resignation of Denise McCue, Data Collector for the Assessor’s Office effective September 10, 2026
items.why_it_matters: A town staff position in the Assessor's Office has become vacant.

items.agenda_line: Refer Articles Submitted by the Planning Board and Director of Planning and Economic Development to the Planning Board
items.why_it_matters: The board will decide how to route articles for the upcoming November Special Town Meeting warrant.

items.agenda_line: Report to Town Meeting Under Article 1: Reports to Town Meeting- Regarding Article 10 of the November 2024 Special Town Meeting “Request to Select Board Re: The Brooks House”
items.why_it_matters: The board will report back to Town Meeting on a prior directive concerning the Brooks House property.

items.agenda_line: Donation of Boulder to be Located in Front of Town Hall
items.why_it_matters: A donated monument would be installed on Town Hall grounds, changing a public building's exterior.

items.agenda_line: Discussion of Opioid Settlement Funds: Use for AEDs in All Town/School Buildings and Police/Fire Vehicles
items.why_it_matters: The board will discuss how to spend money the town received from opioid litigation settlements on defibrillators for town and school buildings and public safety vehicles.
Proposed changes to the town's policy on how appointments are made will be presented to the board.

items.agenda_line: Introduce Boards, Committees, and Commissions Handbook and Next Steps
items.why_it_matters: A new handbook governing town boards, committees, and commissions is being introduced, which could affect how those bodies operate.
The board will discuss the condition or status of town-owned buildings.
The board will discuss matters concerning the town's food pantry, a community support resource.

preview.one_line: Select Board Sept 15, 7PM: earth removal permit renewal, opioid settlement funds for AEDs, Brooks House report, and municipal buildings discussion.
